review.method: Compared local Whisper large-v3-turbo, large-v3 full-run and four large-v3 crop transcriptions; no external lyrics consulted. This partial draft is not human-audio verified.
review.timing: Approximate Whisper word boundaries; singing and instrumental tails require audiovisual timing review.
excluded_hallucinations: Large-v3 crops 58-70, 81-94 and 99-105 seconds produce thanks-for-watching hallucinations

unresolved_spans.reason: Opening sung words are not reliably recovered. Turbo fragments do not establish a credible complete phrase; large-v3 hallucinates prose.
Both models disagree on the predicate after itoshisa wa; do not guess the missing lyric.
Both models produce an implausible fleeting pot reading. The noun is unresolved.
Models disagree between kogarete and kogasete; this changes the lyric's meaning.
Models disagree substantially on the phrase after the two heartbeats line.
Full large-v3 reads this world; turbo and crop read this wish. The noun is not settled, so neither is displayed.
The word watashi is clear but its following particle differs: turbo no, crop ni, full large-v3 omits it. The intervening phrase remains unresolved.

uncertainties: 70-75 seconds is supported only by turbo because large-v3 hallucinated through this passage.
The vow phrase agrees between models but still requires listening confirmation.
The crimson-sky and strength-to-believe readings use large-v3, which is coherent here where turbo is not.
The crop did not resolve world versus wish at 126 seconds; the revised cue starts with the shared ending phrase and leaves the subject unspecified.
The final crop coherently reads mirai tomosu kara, supported in part by both earlier runs. Added this phrase as a draft, while omitting the unresolved watashi particle immediately before it.
Several captions are fragments because adjoining words remain unresolved. This file must not be presented as a complete or final song translation.
